title: High-dimensional learning dynamics of multi-pass Stochastic Gradient Descent in multi-index models
abstract: arXiv:2601.21093v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The learning dynamics of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) are believed to play an important role in influencing the generalization properties of trained models. While the precise dynamics of how online (one-pass) SGD optimizes the population risk are now understood in a broad range of high-dimensional problems, a comparable understanding of multi-pass SGD for empirical risk minimization is still largely lacking.   In this work, we develop an asymptotically exact characterization of the dynamics of multi-pass SGD for a non-convex multi-index model, in the high-dimensional regime where sample size $n$ and data dimension $d$ increase proportionally. We consider any sub-linear batch size $\kappa \asymp n^\alpha$ with $\alpha \in [0,1)$ and a commensurate ``critical'' scaling of the learning rate, and show that the coordinate-wise dynamics of SGD admit a novel continuous-time scaling limit, given by a system of dynamical mean-field

translated_title: 多指标模型中多轮随机梯度下降的高维学习动力学
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）的学习动力学被认为对训练模型的泛化性能有着重要影响。尽管在线（单遍）SGD如何精确优化总体风险的动力学已在广泛的高维问题中得到理解，但对于用于经验风险最小化的多遍SGD，类似的理解在很大程度上仍然缺失。在这项工作中，我们在样本量n与数据维度d成比例增长的高维区间内，为非凸多指标模型的多遍SGD动力学建立了渐近精确的刻画。我们考虑任意次线性批量大小κ ≍ n^α（其中α ∈ [0,1)）以及相应的“临界”学习率缩放，并证明SGD的逐坐标动力学具有一种新颖的连续时间缩放极限，该极限由一组动力学平均场（方程给出）……
tldr: 本文在样本量与维度成比例的高维区间内，首次对非凸多指标模型上的多遍随机梯度下降动力学建立了渐近精确的刻画，证明其收敛于一种新颖的动力学平均场连续时间极限，且适用于任意次线性批量大小及相应的临界学习率缩放。
en_tdlr: This work provides an asymptotically exact characterization of multi-pass SGD dynamics on non-convex multi-index models in the proportional high-dimensional regime, showing that the coordinate-wise dynamics converge to a novel continuous-time dynamical mean-field scaling limit for any sub-linear batch size with commensurate critical learning-rate scaling.
